# Start Transforming Throttle

Source: [wiki article 4457](../archive/4457.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Start Transforming Throttle](../../api/actions/start-transforming-throttle.md).

<a id="wiki-4457-n1"></a>

- Transforming throttle cancels a previous transform; it scales left/right X and forward/back Y before rotating input.

<a id="wiki-4457-n2"></a>

- Axis scalars and relative direction always reevaluate every frame; relative direction is normalized.

<a id="wiki-4457-n3"></a>

- Supplying camera-facing direction makes movement camera-relative.
